status: DERIVED SCOPED COROLLARY OF THE SAME FIRST-HIT OVERLAP ANALYSIS; not a repair of the rejected all-depth law
definition: Fix one integer origin o in ordered carrier ranks and one absolute k>=0. A proper carrier interval I is canonical at depth d>=1 when I=[o+j*2^(d+1)+1,o+(j+1)*2^(d+1)-1] for an integer j. At a hit of carrier rank x in I, define delta=d-v2(abs(x-o))>=0.
birth_class: All actual original B SET birth runs of such intervals whose first hit has delta<=k. Their first-hit real-A map has load<=k+1, uniformly over all sizes and arbitrary restoration.
original_quantity: R_(o,k) is the literal original U_int double class whose whole frame is such a canonical interval and whose producer target has delta<=k. Keep full original neutral/interior/Pi predicates.
theorem: R_(o,k)(W)<=(k+1)*K_B(W)<=(k+1)*A(W), for all admissible exactly paired-closed original sources with the original fixed ancestor-closed carrier S. At a B access x, canonical depths containing x satisfy d>=v2(abs(x-o)); eligible depths are at most k+1. Whole frames strictly expand in carrier cardinality along an original splay, so at most one demand per eligible depth. Distinct original KEEP gaps give distinct real A cost units.
not_a_size_budget_sum: Count multiplicity at a single actual A representative across all sizes, then sum original disjoint KEEP gaps once.
nonvacuity: In the new h>=3 source, the first internal probe LL has original whole frame L3 and delta2. Uniform full E inflation raises both d and v2(x-o) together, producing arbitrarily large covered frames with unchanged delta2 and exact all-key closure.
complement: Noncanonical original U frames, and canonical frames with delta>k. In the new stack, forced frames L_(2j+1) have delta2j, unbounded with h. No free sum over k or over origins is proved.
why_prior_rules_survive: One-size injection remains correct. Raw all-scale first-hit pooling is false. This corollary states its exact bounded-alignment scope and explicitly leaves the diagnosed high-deficit class open.
